paper_title: Cross-Receiver Radio Frequency Fingerprint Identification Based on Domain Adaptation With Dynamic Distribution Alignment
input_representation: WiSig compact IQ [2,256] after channel equalization and energy normalization
method: DADDA with a modified ResNet18-style G_f, 2-D paper-shaped multiscale G_m, MMD, LMMD, and dynamic adaptive factor alpha treated as a batch scalar weight
paper_sample_interpretation: 4000 samples per transmitter within each receiver domain; ManySig provides 6 x 4000 = 24000 samples per receiver domain
